title: The Murder of Rachel Nickell
plot_overview: A young mother is killed in broad daylight on London's Wimbledon Common, in front of her toddler. This documentary examines the yearslong murder case, focusing on the crime and the investigation that followed while exploring its lasting impact on those connected to it.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you prefer serious true-crime documentaries such as Bikram: Yogi, Guru, Predator or The Menendez Brothers; Not for you if disturbing cases feel too intense.
review_summary: Pros: compelling real case; serious subject matter; investigative focus | Cons: disturbing premise; emotionally heavy; limited review context
